meta.title: Independent reference map: technical-military core authority (level 2.5 + operational meaning)

importance.K: Key: master at full 2.5 depth (structure, derivation skeleton, limits, orders of magnitude, trade-offs, critique, operational meaning)
importance.S: Supporting: solid working use; know the result, its assumptions and how it is misused; no full derivation
importance.C: Context: conversant; vocabulary, order of magnitude, who to ask
importance.N: Not needed for this goal (engineer/implementer detail)

meta.op_bg: likely/partial/unlikely that a strong operational background already covers the subtopic; 'test_out' = K/S items marked likely: verify with a short test rather than skip
meta.lab_part: nearest Lanchester syllabus part (P0..P13), 'ref' = analysis reference books, '-' = no home in current syllabus

sources.NPS360: NPS Operations Analysis curriculum 360 (OA3602 Search Theory & Detection, OA4655 Joint Combat Modeling, OA4602 Joint Campaign Analysis, OA4604 Wargaming, OA4702 Cost Estimation, OA3304 Decision Theory, OA3302/OA4333 Simulation; ESR 3211P incl. 'Analysis of Military Applications') - nps.smartcatalogiq.com
sources.NPS533: NPS Applied Physics of Combat Systems curriculum 533 (EM radiation, signal processing, optoelectronics, servo/control, explosives & warheads, combat simulation, detectors) + SE2101/SE3113/SE3116/SE4117 (sensors, conventional weapons, lasers, directed energy)
sources.NPSEW: NPS EW Engineer certificates 292/293 (EC3600, EC3615, EC3630, EC3700, EC4685: EW principles, radar, microwave/optical aspects of sensor & EW systems); NPS EW (Intl) 596
sources.NPSSS: NPS Space Systems Operations 366 / Space Systems Engineering 591 (SS3011 Space Technology & Applications, SS3051 Military Applications of DoD & Commercial Space, SS3613 Military SATCOM, SS4055 Space Operations for the Warfighter)
sources.AFIT: AFIT graduate programs (EW, space systems, OR/combat modeling, systems engineering), AFIT/CSRA short courses
sources.CRAN_GWS: Cranfield/Defence Academy Shrivenham MSc Guided Weapon Systems (Control & Guidance, EO/IR, Propulsion, Aerodynamics, Systems Integration, Missile Systems Design, Radar EW / GW-EW, Hypersonic GW)
sources.CRAN_MESE: Cranfield MSc Military Electronic Systems Engineering (EM propagation, signal processing, statistics, EO/IR 1-2, comms principles & systems, radar principles, advanced sensor data processing, comms EW, M&S)
sources.GTRI: Georgia Tech Professional Education: Principles of Modern Radar (DEF 3502), Basic Radar Concepts (DEF 3501), Principles of Radar Electronic Protection (DEF 2505)
sources.SKOL: Skolnik, Introduction to Radar Systems / Radar Handbook - TOC
sources.RICH: Richards, Fundamentals of Radar Signal Processing; Richards/Scheer/Holm, Principles of Modern Radar vols I-III - TOC
sources.ADAMY: Adamy, EW101-EW104 (link eq., receivers, search, emitter location, jamming, decoys, LPI, comms EW, EW against new threats) - TOC
sources.SCHL: Schleher, Electronic Warfare in the Information Age; Neri, Introduction to EW Systems - TOC
sources.DRIG: Driggers/Friedman/Nichols, Intro to IR & EO Systems; Holst; NV-IPM/TTP performance modeling
sources.KAPL: Kaplan & Hegarty, Understanding GPS/GNSS; Groves, Principles of GNSS, Inertial & Multisensor Integrated Navigation - TOC
sources.ZARCH: Zarchan, Tactical and Strategic Missile Guidance (PN, adjoints, miss distance, noise, Kalman, Lambert, strategic intercepts, weaving targets, autopilots) - TOC
sources.FLEE: Fleeman, Tactical Missile Design / Missile Design and System Engineering (aero, propulsion, weight, flight performance, measures of merit, cost, sizing) - TOC
sources.SIOU: Siouris, Missile Guidance and Control Systems - TOC
sources.BALL: Ball, Fundamentals of Aircraft Combat Survivability Analysis & Design (kill chain, susceptibility/vulnerability, FMECA, kill trees, P(k/h), signatures, survivability enhancement)
sources.SMAD: Wertz et al., Space Mission Engineering: The New SMAD - TOC
sources.WK: Washburn & Kress, Combat Modeling (shooting with/without feedback, target defense, attrition models, game theory & wargames, search, mine warfare, UAVs, terror & insurgency)
sources.PRZ: Przemieniecki, Mathematical Methods in Defense Analyses (Lanchester, kill probabilities, target coverage, reliability, cost-effectiveness)
sources.HUGH: Hughes & Girrier, Fleet Tactics and Naval Operations (salvo equations, scouting, C2, attrition at sea)
sources.BOORD: Boord & Hoffman, Air and Missile Defense Systems Engineering - TOC
sources.URICK: Urick, Principles of Underwater Sound; USNA Principles of Naval Weapons Systems
sources.GLAS: Glasstone & Dolan, The Effects of Nuclear Weapons
sources.JMEM: Joint Munitions Effectiveness Manual concepts, JP 3-60 Joint Targeting, weaponeering practice
sources.JP: US Joint doctrine: JP 3-01 Countering Air & Missile Threats, JP 3-85 Joint Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations, JP 3-14 Space Operations, JP 3-09 Joint Fire Support, JP 2-0 Intelligence, JP 3-30, JP 5-0
sources.DAU: Defense Acquisition University curricula: DoD 5000 / Adaptive Acquisition Framework, PPBE, cost estimating (CEBoK), TRL/MRL, DT&E/OT&E, sustainment, industrial base
sources.DOTE: DOT&E annual reports and OT&E practice; TEMP structure; live-fire T&E (LFT&E)
sources.RAND: RAND methods & reports: campaign analysis, sortie generation, exchange ratios, wargaming, uncertainty (RDM/exploratory modeling), munitions demand, Hidden in plain sight / scorecards (e.g., US-China Military Scorecard)
sources.CSBA: CSBA analyses: precision-strike regime, salvo competition, cost-imposing strategies, munitions & magazine depth, budget analysis
sources.CSIS: CSIS Missile Defense Project (cost & value of intercepts, interceptor inventory depletion), Aerospace Security Project (space threat assessment), CSIS wargames
sources.CNS: James Martin CNS (Middlebury) OSINT: satellite imagery, GIS, 3D modeling, photo/video analysis, scientific-publication analysis, missile-test databases, sanctions-evasion tracking
sources.BELL: Bellingcat / Berkeley Protocol on Digital Open Source Investigations: geolocation, chronolocation, verification, archiving, ethics
sources.EXPORT: ITAR/USML, EAR/CCL, Wassenaar, MTCR Category I/II thresholds, US/Israeli security review of publications (DoDI 5230.09 prepublication review; Israeli military censor)
sources.IISS: IISS Military Balance, SIPRI arms transfers/expenditure databases, FAS
sources.VANC: van Creveld, Supplying War; Huston/Kress operational logistics; RAND sustainment studies
sources.HIST: Operational history & lessons literature (Gulf War Air Power Survey, Kosovo, 2006/2014/2021-2024 Israel campaigns, Ukraine 2022-, Nagorno-Karabakh 2020, Red Sea 2023-25, Iran-Israel exchanges 2024-25)
sources.ATP: Russian/Chinese military writings via FMSO/ATP 7-100.x (US Army threat doctrine), CASI (China Aerospace Studies Institute), Grau & Bartles 'The Russian Way of War'
sources.SE: INCOSE/NASA SE Handbook, MIL-STD-882 (system safety), reliability (MIL-HDBK-217/338), MBSE practice
sources.CYB: Cyber/EMSO convergence literature (JP 3-12, NPS cyber-EW courses, MIT/CSIS work on cyber-physical weapon systems)
